verbatim_excerpt:
The alteration of an existing building resulting in both the removal of more than 75 percent of the floor area and more than 25 percent of the perimeter walls of such existing building, and the replacement of any amount of floor area, shall be considered a development for the purposes of the following provisions. The provisions of this Section shall apply notwithstanding the provisions of Article V (Non-Conforming Uses and Non-Complying Buildings). However, these provisions shall not apply where the building to be replaced is a single- or two-family residence utilizing the provisions of Article V.

capture_does_not_establish: This capture does NOT make the legal reading of §5b's path-2 wall trap. It records the 'development' definition and the Article V notwithstanding/exception clauses verbatim, plus the full published list of 'following provisions' this section routes a deemed-development to. It does not decide whether any building meets the >75% floor-area + >25% perimeter-wall + replacement test, nor which of the 36 listed provisions apply to a given site - that is rule-author work for a later DRAFT rule, never published without G6.

notes: Captured because §54-41 paragraph 2 cross-references 'Section 11-23 (Demolition and Replacement)' by name for the §5b path-2 wall trap. Paragraph 1 is the operative clause: the same >75% floor-area + >25% perimeter-wall + replacement alteration is a 'development', applies notwithstanding Article V, and does NOT apply where the replaced building is a single- or two-family residence using Article V. The remaining 36 paragraphs are the published list of 'following provisions' (verbatim, digest-covered) and are second-order cross-references, not captured as separate sections in this step.
Captured fresh in-task as cross-reference provenance for the §5b DRAFT comparison rule (M2-08).
